✨ Hotel Review – Mraguen Hotel, Adrar ✨

"I had an excellent stay at Mraguen Hotel. Even though I arrived late at Adrar airport, the transport person was waiting for me with kindness and professionalism. The reception team was fantastic, welcoming me warmly. The food was delicious, the rooms very clean and cozy, and I was pleasantly surprised to find my dinner already prepared inside the room. The guard team at the entrance was also very polite and friendly. Overall, the service was outstanding, and I truly appreciate the care and hospitality shown at every step."
Thanks to all teams🤗👍❤️

I had a great experience with Mraguen when I travelled to Adrar, Algeria for work. Experience was beyond my expectations, to be frank i had pretty low expectations. Down south of Algeria you will need security escort to move anywhere so this hotel/resort was a heaven, since it had lots of space in the property to move around. Close to nature keep, peacocks, birds, cats it was good to make some friends. I was there during winter so the temperatures were dropping rapidly at night. The hotel provided great house keeping, laundry was complimentary and the room rates were reasonable. Best part was the dinner buffet which was too at a reasonable price with lots of options, although it was served from 8pm, which was late for my other colleagues who are used to having early dinner. Look and feel of the property was great and it is a traditional Algerian property of the south.
